    docs: README names no ids; only mechanical self-checks block (AD-7)
    
    - README prose no longer cites axioms (A0-A7, M1-M4) or decisions; the
      sample check output keeps its ids, as the CLI prints them. AD-4 lands
      in AGENTS.md, which already names it.
    - AD-5 (the rename) is gone, with its README sentence: the earlier name
      was never published, so there is nobody to migrate.
    - AD-7: while docaxioms is in development, this repository's own check
      blocks a merge only on links and anchors, paths, commands and the
      axiom pin, held by test/self.test.mjs. npm run check prints the rest
      with --report. Each check blocks again one at a time, on the owner's
      word, after a trial as a report in another real project.
